value.rationale: Shapiro's 2023 open question asks for all-level ComboSum integrality, but previously known chain and divisor-product sufficient conditions do not encompass the explicit family from the numerical semigroups <2,2q+1>. The theorem supplies a structural universal criterion for all columns, sharply distinguishes two-step from three-step divisibility and gives a nontrivial infinite subclass of the open question rather than an arbitrary finite example.
